TALLENTEX 2024 — Class 8th (Paper Code M) — Computer Based Test

80 QuestionsMaximum Marks: 320 Duration: 2 Hours+4 for correct −1 for wrongDiagrams included

This is the same TALLENTEX Class-8 paper (Paper Code M) converted into a real CBT interface: the timer runs at the top, every diagram is shown along with its question, and after you press Submit on the last question you get your result, the correct/incorrect status of each question, the official answers and full solutions, plus the scholarship percentage as per TALLENTEX rules.

Instructions

  1. Duration of the test is 2 hours (120 minutes). The clock starts as soon as you click Start Test.
  2. The paper has 80 multiple-choice questions with four choices (1), (2), (3), (4). Only one is correct (except two questions, 61 & 62, and 69, where the official key accepts two answers).
  3. Marking scheme: +4 for every correct answer, −1 for every wrong answer (negative marking), 0 if not attempted. Question 9 is a Bonus question — it gives +4 to everyone, as per the official key.
  4. Section distribution: Physics 15, Chemistry 15, Biology 15, Mathematics 15, Mental Ability (IQ) 20.
  5. Use the palette on the right to jump to any question. Colour code: Answered, Not answered, Marked for review, Not visited.
  6. Keyboard shortcuts: 1 2 3 4 select an option, ← → previous/next question, c clear, m mark for review.
  7. If the timer reaches 00:00:00 the test is submitted automatically. The result page then shows your score, subject-wise analysis, the scholarship slab and the complete solution of all 80 questions.
